channel.description: Latest articles from The Berkshire Edge (theberkshireedge.com)

item.title: Pittsfield resident dies after being rescued from house fire
item.description: The fire remains under investigation by state and city officials.

item.title: From the school committee to the streets of Great Barrington, Berkshire County braces against threat of ICE
item.description: As Berkshire Hills Regional School District prepares for possible ICE enforcement, over 200 residents take to the streets in Great Barrington against the agency and the Trump administration.

item.title: Protecting DEI
item.description: In the age of Trump, we see people with deep financial resources who have benefited from white privilege using the courts to continue that form of discrimination.

item.title: Mercy, mercy, mercy
item.description: It will not be the courts, laws, councils, a different political party, or any of the old systems and structures that will rescue us from the chaos. What is arising is arising so it may be seen and then may be released.

item.title: BITS & BYTES: Barrington Stage Company 10×10 New Play Festival; Close Encounters With Music presents ‘Endings’; W.E.B. Du Bois Freedom Center presents Scottsboro Boys Traveling Exhibit; Jewish Federation presents The Braid; Living in Recovery Sober-Bowl Party; Freestyle dance at Becket Arts Center
item.description: Catch Barrington Stage Company favorites in the spotlight as 100 minutes of dreams, drama, and pure delight unfold on BSC's St. Germain Stage.

item.title: WHERE WE ARE: Molly and Aurélien de St. Andre of Bon Dimanche/Petit Pilou
item.description: The fun, bright, and bold cacti, pasta shapes, dogs and pineapple designs from Molly and Aurel’s Petit Pilou clothing line have become a staple feature of South County fashion for babies, kids, and adults as well.

item.title: W.E.B. Du Bois’ great-grandson to star in play celebrating his legacy
item.description: In a celebration of his great-grandfather's legacy, Jeffrey DuBois Peck will star in the title role of "W.E.B. Du Bois: An American Hero" at Monument Mountain on Feb. 21.

item.title: Andrew Fitch of North Adams to run for 1st Berkshire District seat in State House
item.description: According to his campaign website, Fitch is running on a platform focused on community development, education, and transportation, along with affordability and regional collaboration.

item.title: Mourning Minneapolis
item.description: Created in the shadow of lives lost and families forever changed, "Weight of the World" translates public tragedy into visual form.

item.title: NICK DILLER: Fickle January 2026 weather
item.description: Despite the snow, this January was the third driest and eighth coldest since 2000.
